About this item

  • AI Vana 2.0 Smart Assistant & Dynamic Bar: Enhance everyday productivity with real-time translation, summaries, and voice commands, plus quick access to alerts via the Dynamic Bar and Always-On Display.

  • Smart Camera & Fast Charging: 8MP AI rear + 5MP front cameras with HDR, Beauty Mode, Time-Lapse, and a side Sliding Zoom Button, powered by a 5000mAh battery with 15W Type-C fast charging.

    About this Item

    • AI Vana 2.0 Smart Assistant & Dynamic Bar: Enhance everyday productivity with real-time translation, summaries, and voice commands, plus quick access to alerts via the Dynamic Bar and Always-On Display.
    • Military Grade Certified: Built to last with IP54-rated dust and splash resistance, plus a 3-year fluency guarantee for long-term performance
    • Immersive Visuals & Smooth Experience: 6.56" HD+ display with 90Hz refresh rate and octa-core processor for fluid scrolling, gaming, and media consumption.
    • Powerful Performance & DTS Sound: 3GB RAM (expandable up to 8GB), 64GB ROM, and DTS audio deliver smooth multitasking and rich, immersive sound.
    • Smart Camera & Fast Charging: 8MP AI rear + 5MP front cameras with HDR, Beauty Mode, Time-Lapse, and a side Sliding Zoom Button, powered by a 5000mAh battery with 15W Type-C fast charging.

    Product description

    Experience the itel Zeno 100, a smart 4G smartphone designed for everyday performance with AI Vana 2.0 Smart Assistant and Dynamic Bar for instant access to translation, summaries, and voice commands. Military-grade IP54-rated dust and splash resistance, along with a 3‑year fluency guarantee, ensure long-term reliability for your daily grind. Enjoy immersive entertainment on a 6.56" HD+ display with 90Hz refresh rate and an octa-core processor that keeps scrolling, gaming, and streaming smooth. With 3GB RAM (expandable up to 8GB), 64GB ROM, and DTS audio, the device delivers powerful multitasking and rich, cinematic sound. Capture every moment with a 8MP AI rear camera and 5MP front camera, featuring HDR, Beauty Mode, Time-Lapse, and a unique Sliding Zoom Button, all backed by a 5000mAh battery with 15W Type-C fast charging for all-day power.
